of.needed: whether two or more DestinationRules target the same host with totally different (non-overlapping) exportTo values; this needs a comparison across resources that a single-resource condition cannot express

consequence.statement: DestinationRules on the same host whose exportTo attributes are totally different are no longer merged, so the effective traffic policy for such configurations may differ from before. This lasts unless ENABLE_ENHANCED_DESTINATIONRULE_MERGE is set to false in the pilot deployment.
consequence.remediation: Check DestinationRules that share a host but have totally different exportTo values. To keep the previous merging, set ENABLE_ENHANCED_DESTINATIONRULE_MERGE=false in the pilot deployment.

evidence.excerpt:
- |
  **Fixed** DestinationRules on same host but with different ExportTo can behave inconsistently, so stop merging the destinationRules when the exportTo attributes are totally different. If you want to toggle this behavior, you can set the `ENABLE_ENHANCED_DESTINATIONRULE_MERGE` environment variable to `false` in the pilot deployment.
